description: Container internals decomposed. OCI image layers + manifest, content-addressable storage, registry V2 API, BuildKit, image squashing, namespaces/cgroups (from OS) applied, runc's container start sequence.

sub_mechanisms.name: image_manifest_v2
sub_mechanisms.definition: JSON: config (image metadata, env, cmd) + layers (digest, size). OCI image-spec.
sub_mechanisms.why: Manifest is image identity. Pull manifest first; decide which layers to fetch. Foundation of image distribution.

sub_mechanisms.name: content_addressable_layers
sub_mechanisms.definition: Each layer identified by SHA256 of contents. Same layer in many images: stored once.
sub_mechanisms.why: Deduplication. Base image layers shared. Pull only missing layers. Standard OCI storage.

sub_mechanisms.name: registry_v2_API
sub_mechanisms.definition: REST API for image push/pull. Blob upload + manifest upload. Docker Hub, ECR, GCR all implement.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard interface. Tooling vendor-neutral. Federated registries possible. OCI distribution-spec.

sub_mechanisms.name: BuildKit_modern_builder
sub_mechanisms.definition: Modern Docker build engine. Parallel + cache-aware + multiple frontends.
sub_mechanisms.why: Replaces classic dockerfile parser. Cache mounts (mount cache during build), secrets in build (BuildKit secrets), multi-platform builds. Default since Docker 23.

sub_mechanisms.name: buildah_rootless_builds
sub_mechanisms.definition: Build OCI images without daemon. Rootless. Used by podman.
sub_mechanisms.why: Daemon-less. Rootless build = better security. CI-friendly: no docker daemon needed.

sub_mechanisms.name: image_squash
sub_mechanisms.definition: Combine multiple layers into one. Reduces size at cost of layer reuse.
sub_mechanisms.why: Trade: smaller image, but less caching benefit. Use for distroless-final stages where final image is the deployable.

sub_mechanisms.name: container_start_namespaces
sub_mechanisms.definition: runc creates: mount, pid, network, ipc, uts, user namespaces. Sets up cgroups. Execs application.
sub_mechanisms.why: Container = namespaces + cgroups + chroot-like rootfs. runc orchestrates the Linux primitives. Standard OCI runtime behaviour.

sub_mechanisms.name: OCI_runtime_bundle
sub_mechanisms.definition: Filesystem directory: config.json (runtime spec) + rootfs/. runc starts container from bundle.
sub_mechanisms.why: Decouples image (distribution format) from runtime input. CRI converts image → bundle. Universal across runtimes.

sub_mechanisms.name: CRI_container_runtime_interface
sub_mechanisms.definition: K8s ↔ runtime gRPC API. kubelet → CRI → containerd/CRI-O → OCI runtime → namespaces.
sub_mechanisms.why: Decouples K8s from specific runtime. Multiple runtimes possible. Standard since K8s 1.5.

sub_mechanisms.name: overlayfs_storage_driver
sub_mechanisms.definition: Linux union FS. Lower layers (read-only image) + upper (writable container).
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard container storage. Copy-on-write: read from lower, write to upper. Fast container creation (just create upper layer).

sub_mechanisms.name: image_signing_cosign
sub_mechanisms.definition: Sigstore cosign signs images; verifier checks at pull. Public log (Rekor).
sub_mechanisms.why: Image provenance. Verify image is from expected publisher. K8s admission policies enforce. Modern supply chain practice.

sub_mechanisms.name: image_attestations
sub_mechanisms.definition: SBOM, SLSA provenance, scan results attached to image as referenced artifacts.
sub_mechanisms.why: Verifiable supply chain. Sigstore + OCI v1.1 references. Modern container security baseline.

derivation_rules.name: content_addressing_enables_dedup
if: images reference layers by content hash
then: same layer stored once across many images
derivation_rules.why: Ubuntu base in 100 images = stored once. Pull = fetch only missing layers. Massive bandwidth + storage savings. Standard OCI design.

derivation_rules.name: BuildKit_cache_mounts_speed_builds
if: build uses cache mounts for package managers
derivation_rules.why: npm/pip/cargo caches persist across builds. Without cache mount: redownload every build. With: incremental. BuildKit secret + cache mounts the modern standard.

derivation_rules.name: multi_stage_for_minimal_runtime
if: Dockerfile separates build from runtime stage
derivation_rules.why: Build stage: gcc, headers, npm. Runtime stage: just binary. Final image 10-100x smaller. Smaller attack surface. Standard pattern.

derivation_rules.name: CRI_decouples_K8s_from_runtime
derivation_rules.why: kubelet doesn't know which runtime. Standard interface. Sandbox runtimes (gVisor, Kata) plug in. Modular K8s.

derivation_rules.name: image_signing_required_for_supply_chain_security
derivation_rules.why: Without: malicious image could be deployed (image tags mutable). With: cosign verifies signature; admission rejects unsigned. Modern security baseline.
